title: Drift Wood #23 · Gully asks
logline: Gully asks the question directly. Wood answers a different one.

panels.composition: The boat launch in October rain. GULLY on his uncle's dock coiling rope. WOOD on an upturned crab pot with the pad.

characters.pose: sitting on a crab pot, drawing

balloons.text: Chloe says you got a letter.

image.prompt: a boy in a backwards cap coiling rope on a small wooden dock in the rain while a boy in an overcoat sits on an upturned crab pot drawing

balloons.text: Chloe says a lot of things. She's the culture editor.

image.prompt: close-up of a teenage boy drawing on a pad in the rain, not looking up

characters.pose: rope in hand, looking at him

image.prompt: a boy in a backwards cap standing still on a dock with a coil of rope, looking plainly at someone

panels.composition: Wood holds up the pad: a drawing of Gully coiling rope, the dock, the rain, better than the actual dock. He says nothing about the letter. Gully looks at the drawing a long time.

image.prompt: a teenage boy holding up a drawing pad showing a finely hatched sketch of a dock in rain to a boy in a backwards cap who looks at it for a long moment, the real dock behind them, black and white

notes: Gully asks the only direct question anyone asks about the scholarship. The answer is a drawing.
